summary.decision_summary: Squat won by 67.3. Squat left 15.2 lineup points on the table, while In Purdytory left 45.4.
summary.historical_summary: Squat is 6-6 against In Purdytory across 12 meetings between these managers.
summary.winner_reason: Squat won by 67.3, led by a 34.0-point edge at WR. The leading starters were Tyler Shough (31.1) and James Cook III (27.4). Recent pickup Bengals added 3.0 lineup points.
summary.loser_reason: In Purdytory could not match the opponent's WR production, losing that position battle by 34.0 points. De'Von Achane scored 2.7. A best legal lineup added 45.4, still short of the 67.3-point margin.
